crossRefs.note: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?”…
Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of…

translations.web: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.
translations.bsb: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
translations.kjv: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near
translations.asv: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, Else they will not come near unto thee.
